sentences: Many laptops can never get a RAM upgrade.
Here's how to tell before you buy.
Thicker laptops often use S O DIMMs.
These are small removable sticks in a slot, so you can add more.
Lots of thin laptops use L P D D R, low power memory.
The chips are soldered right onto the board.
What you buy is what you keep.
A newer option, L P CAMM 2, puts that memory on a small module held by a screw.
It first showed up in the Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 7, and it can be swapped.
So check the spec sheet for a slot or the word soldered.
If it's soldered, buy enough on day one.
Every kind of RAM is in our full video, Every Type of RAM Explained.
